name: Hat de
summary: Hạt dẻ, chestnuts, are one of the specialties sold at the Mang Den weekend market.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen, the weekend market, meets on Saturday and Sunday on the pine hill along Hùng Vương. Báo Kon Tum also places it in the pine garden (Vườn thông) by the district central square.
seoDescription: Hạt dẻ, chestnuts, at the Mang Den weekend market.
